title: sharm: nsumt = 5 without a previous file, orientation test; mapgr, mapgrentropy
purpose: Covers special paths of `sharm` [@epsrmanual]: accumulation requested with no previous coefficient file, an `rmax` larger than half the box, and the built-in orientation test (`test` keyword) that evaluates the expansion for fixed molecular orientations; the test coefficients are then fed into `mapgrentropy`.
fortran: `sharm_rev2.f`: `run_sharm` (keywords, `nsumt` rule), `sharm` (centres, axes, pair loop, averaged molecules)
system: The EPSR-test configuration `200DMSO400Water.ato`: 200 DMSO (atoms S, C, C, O, 6 H) and 400 water molecules (O1, H1, H1; SPC/E parameters [@berendsen1987]), 3200 atoms at 300 K in a cubic box of side 33.12 Å, a model of the DMSO-water mixtures of Soper and Luzar [@soperluzar1992]. `sharm` expands the orientational pair correlation function of a central and a second molecule type in rotation matrices coupled by Clebsch-Gordan coefficients; the coefficients g(l1,l2,l;n1,n2;r) are averages over all molecule pairs [@soper1994,@graygubbins1984]. `watdmso`: central water, second DMSO (DMSO occurs first in the `.ato`, so the "molecule 2 at origin" pass is used), axes z,x and -z,x, l2 = 0 2 3, l = 0-5, n1step 2, n2step 1 (127 coefficients), `averagemol n`. `orient`: `test 10 20 30 40 50 60 70 80` fixes phi/theta/chi of both molecules and the lab vector, axes y,z and y,-z (126 coefficients). `mapgr` rebuilds g(r) along chosen directions and relative orientations from the coefficients (grtype 1 radial, 2 spatial, 3 full orientational). `mapgrentropy` adds to the ideal-gas entropy the two-body excess term, an integral of r²·(g - 1 - g ln g) [@baranyai1989], for the radial, spatial and full g, sampling random orientations with `ran1` [@parkmiller1988].
inputs: Input files written by hand from the keyword tables (`setup_symbols_*`), one `keyword value` per line, ended by `q`; `200DMSO400Water.ato` copied from EPSR-test. `watdmso.SHARM.dat`: `rmax 30`, `nsumt 5`; `orient.SHARM.dat`: extra blanks in `atom-s` (reformatted by `check_symbol`); `mapgr` views grtype 3 and 2; `orient.mapgrentropy.dat`: `ident -1`, `mirrorsym y`, smoothing `1.0 0 1 2`.
verification: Two passes. Pass 1: `outgofzs_sharm` fails to read the missing `.h01` (`nsum = -1`, no averaging); `rmax` is capped to half the box (r step 0.276 Å in `watdmso.mapgr.g01`); pass 2 (`nsumt 6`) skips the calculation, final `nsumt 7`. The orientation test does not increment `nsumt` (0 in the reference), so pass 2 recomputes it. Reference build: `sharm`/`sdf` were rebuilt with one comma inserted in the run-time title format (`'(1h(,'//il1fmt`), since gfortran 15.2 otherwise stops with "Missing comma between descriptors" before writing the coefficients; all other programs are the unmodified reference binaries. Also masked: characters 31-45 of the `*.mapgr.g01` data lines, the error column of `g_centres(r)`, which `mapgrquad.f` never sets (uninitialised in the Fortran, 0 in the port).
